t: The Milwaukee Hook & Pick Set is an essential hand tool kit for precision tasks. Ideal for mechanics, engineers and DIY enthusiasts, it excels in automotive applications such as removing O-rings, seals and gaskets. The 8-piece set features an all-metal core for enhanced durability, while chrome-plated hook and pick shanks provide increased corrosion resistance and help prevent rust build-up. Each tool features a comfort-grip handle with precision knurling for improved control and user comfort during intricate tasks. The set offers versatile tip styles and angles, including flat, hook, bent 45° and bent 90° designs, making it suitable for a wide range of pulling, probing and hose-removal applications. It includes a heavy-duty flat hose pick, heavy-duty 90° hose pick, heavy-duty 45° hose pick, heavy-duty hook hose pick, straight pick, offset hook, standard hook and 90° hook, all supplied in an easy-access storage tray for organised, long-term storage.
